name: Cnú Deiréil

attributes.attribute: harpist in the company of Fionn Mac Cumhaill
great hero whom Cnú served as harpist

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cnú Deiréil was an Irish hero. He played the harp for the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill. The encyclopedia sends the reader to the account under the Dwarves for more detail on him.

okr.objective: Cnú Deiréil is a hero who served Fionn as his harpist.
